description: Relevance-ranked Microsoft IQ context visible to the caller.
notes: Synthetic representative result, not live tenant content. Results are tenant-wide, permission-filtered, capped at 50, and unpaged. Score/lexicalMatch may be null; scores are relative to one query. identifier is a stable correlation digest, not permission to fetch content. data.uri may be null or an open typed pointer discriminated by $type (not the result's media type). Unknown pointer fields/types are preserved; no pointer is fetched automatically. Empty context is a valid result, unlike malformed/error-bearing responses.

query_examples.description: Project query-local relevance, stable identity and summary without following pointers.
Inspect open typed pointers as data; quote the $type JMESPath identifier.
